snippet.title: Super Collapse! (2001) - 4K/60
snippet.description:
Gamehouse has done it again! From the creators of the smash hit Bounce Out comes Collapse, another blow to your productivity that also happens to be great fun. Find rows and columns of three or more like-colored blocks; click them and they disappear, collapsing the rows and columns above. Easy, right? Watch out though, more lines are stacking up at the bottom (and speeding up), and as soon as any column reaches the top, it's game over! Super addictive and great fun for the whole family!

- Special 'Clear the Board' bonus rounds let you really rack up the points!
- Collapse large groups for big bonus points
- Beautiful full screen option
- Start on one of three difficulty levels to set the game difficulty
- Happy color bombs to eliminate all like colored blocks
- Black bombs eliminate all of the blocks in the surrounding area
